MRT Music Kannada presents "Cheluveye Ninna Nodalu" Lyrical Video Song from Hosa Belaku Old Kannada Movie, Ft Dr. Rajkumar, Saritha, Srinivasa Murthy. Sung By Dr. Rajkumar, S. Janaki Music Composed By M. Ranga Rao, Directed By Dorai - Bhagwan.
Movie: Hosa Belaku
Directed by: Dorai - Bhagwan
Produced by: S. A. Srinivas, Sadanand, Rajashekar, Shivaram
Artist Name: Dr. Rajkumar, Saritha, Srinivasa Murthy
Music Director: M. Ranga Rao
Cinematography: B. C. Gowrishankar
Song: Cheluveye Ninna Nodalu
